diagnosis: In rollout 2, A2 disclosed the content of PF1 (the ED's scheduled 22:00-23:00 ultrasound-dependent procedure) via a "say" action at turn 1 instead of a formal "reveal" action, so PF1 never appeared in revealed_facts. The settlement then omitted PF1 from justification_fact_ids (listing only S1, S2, S3, S5, S6, PF2), causing provenance check P1 to fail. All content checks C1-C4 still passed because the settlement's decisions and commitments contained the correct information, but the provenance gate could not credit PF1 since it was never formally revealed. The other three rollouts all used proper "reveal" actions for both PF1 and PF2 and passed P1. This is a disclosure-norm problem, not a telepathy or encoding issue: A2 communicated the right information in the wrong action type.

P1.why: The scheduled procedure changes the assignment to the emergency department and fixes the portable-machine window at exactly 22:00-23:00 instead of leaving either choice open.
